usedFor: Shopify raises store events like “New Product”, and Worksection receives a project through “Create Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Project” in Worksection
bestTemplate.why: A product launch gets its own project, so the team can plan it.

watchOut: “New Project” in Worksection is polling, so the reverse direction waits for a scheduled check.
